title: On the classification of small cyclotomic integers
summary: We give a general classification theorem for cyclotomic algebraic integers with all complex absolute values bounded by a fixed constant $c$, modeled on the theorem of Cassels which treats the case $c = \sqrt{5}$ up to finitely many exceptions. As a corollary, we establish that the range of the function taking a cyclotomic integer to its maximum complex absolute value is a well-ordered (but not closed) subset of the real numbers.
